safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Documenting “no sweating” without clear patient confirmation can slightly distort assessment of possible anaphylaxis severity, since diaphoresis can be a supportive sign of systemic reaction/shock. However, this single negative symptom is unlikely to change management in this context (ambulance/hospital evaluation is still indicated based on breathing tightness and lip tingling).
